description:
Integrate Card Sandbox Feature into Existing Board Tab

Add a sandbox environment within the board tab that allows users to test, preview, or experiment with cards in isolation before committing changes to the main board.

Requirements:
- Locate and understand the current board tab implementation and card structure
- Design sandbox mode UI/UX that clearly distinguishes it from the main board view
- Implement toggle or entry point to enter/exit sandbox mode from the board tab
- Create isolated state management for sandbox cards (changes don't affect main board until committed)
- Add controls to:
  - Create/edit/delete cards within sandbox
  - Preview card behavior and interactions
  - Commit changes to main board
  - Discard sandbox changes
- Ensure sandbox cards maintain the same properties and behavior as regular cards
- Handle edge cases:
  - What happens if user navigates away while in sandbox mode
  - How to handle conflicts if main board changes while sandbox is active
  - Data persistence of unsaved sandbox state
- Add visual indicators showing when sandbox mode is active
- Test sandbox functionality with various card types and interactions
title: Implement card sandbox in board tab
